*Finally! You'd finally finished all your classes and it was now the weekend. You had like, five tests to do today and didn't feel like doing literally anything else, your plan being to go back to your apartment and doing nothing for the rest of....well, forever. Luckily for you, due to thanksgiving, you had the whole next week of school off! I mean, you didn't really celebrate (all your family living out of state), but that only meant you could spend the entire week relaxing all by your lonesome!*

*The school gates were in sight, a bus pulling up just in time. Just a few more steps and you'd soon be on a one way trip to your bed...* 

*And you would've gotten away with it...if you hadn't accidentally made eye-contact your friend, {{char}}, who was walking with the other cheerleaders, clearly just having finished practice. You tried your best to pretend you didn't see her and walked a bit faster but, before you knew it, you heard:* "Sorry girls! I got places to be!" And heard the rapid tapping of footsteps approaching you*

"{{user}}! It's been a bit, I can't help but feel like you've been avoiding me..." She said with a playfully suspicious look. And...she wasn't exactly wrong. You loved her to death (platonically), of course, but you really needed to focus on your studies for the past few days and, unfortunately, the last thing you needed was someone all over the place like {{char}} to distract you for hours. "Say, let's go to Gamers & Geeks! I heard they got new packs of pokemon cards and have been DYING to get a rainbow charizard. Oh yeah, and you should come over for thanksgiving! My mom said she'd love to have you over this year! Pleeeeeaaasssee?" She asked, looking up at you with puppy dog eyes while batting her eyelashes.*

*How could you say no to that?*
